title: Dahi Tadka Toastie

items: 6 slices of bread, use any that you prefer ( macros are basis standard white bread )

method: Hang curd for 4-6 hours and then refridgerate
tips: Drop the carbs by almost half by making it an open toastie and only cook the bottom in tadka
caption:
Dahi Tadka Toastie

Nutrition:
C: 42 | F: 6 | P: 12
Calories: 266 per serve ( 1 sandwich ) 
Makes filling for 2 - 3 Sandwiches 

Ingredients
400 grams curd
1/2 onion, finely chopped
1/4 green capsicum, small cubes 
grated carrot, optional 
1 - 2 green chilli, chopped 
salt + pepper 
1/4 tsp tobasco 
1 tsp green chutney

tadka to cook 
knobb of ghee 
rai
curry leaves

6 slices of bread, use any that you prefer ( macros are basis standard white bread ) 

Method
hang curd for 4-6 hours and then refridgerate 
( you can use greek yogurt if you prefer and don’t have time though it is slightly runny comparatively ) 
chop up your veges
combine everything in a bowl together 
top one slice with the mix and on the other slice, add the chutney
in a pan, add little ghee then the rai and curry leaf 
add in the sandwich and cook on both sides
serve it fresh :) 

pro tip: 
drop the carbs by almost half by making it an open toastie and only cook the bottom in tadka
